messages:
deploy-bot: Config-only deploy queued: `cfg-2026-03-routing-16`. Change window: 10m canary -> full. Params: routing_policy=cost-aware, max_batch_tokens=512, batch_window_ms=12, request_timeout_ms=3000. No model changes. Rolling canary 1/50. Deploy ID d-1759994321
carla: ack. will monitor p95/p50 latency and error-rate. @deepak can you watch infra metrics?
deepak: watching metrics. will set alert for p95 > 3000ms or error-rate > 0.5% on canary.
andrew: small nit — `batch_window_ms=12` seems aggressive for spike patterns; can we add `burst_window_ms=25` to absorb micro-bursts?
maya: we need to pin routing for billing-group-x to avoid cross-tenant variability. carla: can you confirm pin?
carla: pinning billing-group-x to legacy routing until 02:00 UTC, rolling rest. Doing canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary start: instances affected: canary-1 (region us-west2). Start time 1759994330. Health checks: OK so far.
deepak: p50: 95ms -> baseline 90ms. p95: 420ms -> baseline 380ms. error-rate 0.08% -> baseline 0.03%. small uptick, but within expected for batching change. continuing to watch for 5m.
andrew: if error-rate continues rising, fallback plan: reduce `max_batch_tokens` to 256 and increase `batch_window_ms` to 20. prefer adjusting before rollback.
maya: agree. alert me if error-rate > 0.3% or p95 > 700ms.
deploy-bot: Canary health alert: p95 spike to 820ms on canary-1 at 1759994368. error-rate 0.45%.
deepak: seeing TPM spikes coinciding with long tails. initiating mitigation: throttling incoming from heavy clients, andrew please run quick config tweak to `batch_window_ms=18`.
andrew: pushed config change to canary: `batch_window_ms=18`, `max_batch_tokens=384`. log: /ops/changes/d-1759994321/patch.log
deploy-bot: Config patched on canary. Re-evaluating.
deepak: p95 back to 500ms, error-rate down to 0.12%. holding. recommendation: continue canary for another 10m; no rollback.
carla: agree. note for release notes: mention cost-aware routing toggle and batch tuning. after 20m if stable, promote. @maya will coordinate pin removal.
maya: I'll plan pin removal at +25m. release note draft: 'config: default routing_policy -> cost-aware; batch_window tuned to improve throughput for long-tail requests; added burst_window fallback.'
carla: :thumbsup: adding a short follow-up check for regressions. if anything regresses we have rollback plan (revert config + pin rollback). Closing thread unless more updates.
ops-bot: Reminder: automated rollout will promote to 100% at +30m if canary status remains green.
carla: thanks team, will update final note when promotion completes.
